name: Null-Model Significance Testing via Degree-Preserving Graph Randomization
shortfall_explanation: No matching GPU end-to-end degree-preserving null-ensemble significance artifact was verified. R-MAT generators, random walks and independent edge sampling do not preserve the required degree sequence.
limitation_notes: A matching input variant can qualify without supporting every optional mode. Missing canonical adapters and absent runtime validation remain separate from research collection eligibility.
